import ctypes
import os

def load_gsl_libraries():
    try:
        # Load libgslcblas.so globally first
        ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
        # Load libgsl.so
        gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
        return gsl
    except OSError as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to load GSL libraries: {e}")

def get_gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs_names(gsl):
    try:
        # Access the gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs_lm symbol
        lm = ctypes.cast(gsl.gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs_lm, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p))
        lm_name = ctypes.cast(lm.contents, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p)).contents.value.decode("utf-8")

        # Access the gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs_lmaccel symbol
        lmaccel = ctypes.cast(gsl.gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs_lmaccel, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p))
        lmaccel_name = ctypes.cast(lmaccel.contents, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p)).contents.value.decode("utf-8")

        return {"lm_name": lm_name, "lmaccel_name": lmaccel_name}
    except AttributeError as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to access GSL symbols: {e}")

def assert_test():
    gsl = load_gsl_libraries()
    result = get_gsl_multifit_nlinear_trs_names(gsl)

    # Assertions to validate correctness
    assert result["lm_name"] == "levenberg-marquardt", f"Expected 'levenberg-marquardt', got {result['lm_name']}"
    assert result["lmaccel_name"] == "levenberg-marquardt+accel", f"Expected 'levenberg-marquardt+accel', got {result['lmaccel_name']}"

    print("All tests passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
